title: Rendered copy free of internal ids and placeholders, errors phrased forward
asA: user reading anything the application says
iWant: copy written for me, not for the build system
soThat: nothing on screen reads like scaffolding or blame

acceptanceCriteria.description: No rendered surface in any reachable state contains internal specification identifiers: strings matching REQ-, US-, AC-, FBS-, or blueprint-namespaced id patterns never appear in visible copy.
acceptanceCriteria.given: every route in every reachable state
acceptanceCriteria.when: rendered text is scanned for id patterns

acceptanceCriteria.description: No rendered surface contains lorem ipsum or recognisable placeholder text in any reachable state, including empty, error, and onboarding surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria.when: rendered text is scanned for placeholder markers

acceptanceCriteria.description: Error copy tells the user what happened and what to do next; it does not blame ("you entered an invalid value") or dead-end ("an error occurred").
acceptanceCriteria.given: every error message in the catalogue
acceptanceCriteria.when: copy is reviewed against the actionability rule
acceptanceCriteria.then: each names the situation and a next step

acceptanceCriteria.description: Raw failure internals (stack traces, exception class names, wire payloads) never render to the user in any state.
acceptanceCriteria.then: internals are absent; the problem-details mapping per ADR-204 produced user copy

acceptanceCriteria.description: Empty-state and onboarding copy is product-specific per spa-US-1117; template copy from the blueprint assets is replaced before ship.
acceptanceCriteria.when: copy is compared to blueprint template text
